title: Siyah Kuğu 3
author: Beyza Aksoy
description: In the third book of the series, Siyah Kuğu 3: Göğü Kafes, Nil awakens in an institute alongside other patients undergoing treatment, having erased or lost the final years of her life. Determined to treat everything she once loved—especially the all-consuming passion she chased blindly since childhood—as if it never existed, she now confronts the aftermath with a scalpel in her hand and deep emotional wounds in her soul. As Nil struggles to redraw the boundaries of her past, she learns that the most painful moment of a wound is not when it opens, but when it begins to heal.
